Elena (PM): quick thread to land a decision: what minimal artifacts do we need to unblock a Q3 pilot for the 'Efficiency Adviser' (batching, KV-prefix caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts)?
Tom (Eng): infra must include prefix-cache primitive + tiny batching coordinator. prefer a single simple DSL to start.
Kai (ML): concordance checks are required. nightly job that computes percent-similarity; flag >2% as review. also need an eval-alert taxonomy.
Riley (Solutions): SEs need ROI calc + two simple vignettes. CSV template fields: tokens/session, sessions/day, cost/token, est_pct_save.
Elena (PM): proposing deliverables for Q3 pilot: 1) Console read-only recs + one-click batching preset + ROI CSV; 2) Prefix-cache infra + batch_policy prototype. Enterprise controls later.
Tom (Eng): ok. sample batch_policy DSL to estimate work:
```
batch_policy:
  id: pilot_window
  grouping_key: session_id
  max_wait_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 2500
  prefer_low_latency: true
```
Kai (ML): sample concordance pseudo for nightly eval:
```
orig = run_model(val_set)
quant = run_quant(val_set, cfg)
concordance = compute_similarity(orig, quant) # percent
if concordance < 98.0:
  emit_alert('quant_concordance', details=summary)
```
Anya (ProdDev): acceptance checklist I'll add to stories: feature-flag rollout, <1 extra api call when recs enabled, telemetry (apply-rate, uptake), SLI def for batch p95, rollback plan, security tag for enterprise tenants.
Riley (Solutions): I'll draft two vignettes (Shoply, AcmeHealth) with sample numbers for the ROI CSV and a one-pager for SEs.
Elena (PM): prioritization ask: we can ship two Q3 items. locking: Console recs + ROI CSV first, infra primitives second. any objections?
Tom (Eng): thumbs up. will spike prefix-cache now and push PR by next Tue. mark infra deps on both stories.
Kai (ML): I'll write the eval taxonomy (sample/model/infra -> info/warn/critical) and the nightly harness by Wed.
Riley (Solutions): will coordinate pilot signups and prepare demo scripts. keep default alert thresholds conservative to avoid noise.
Anya (ProdDev): adding acceptance checklist and tagging security + SRE.
orch-bot: created OPT-1313 Efficiency Adviser Q3 pilot (owner: Elena).
Elena (PM): final messaging line: "Efficiency Adviser: reduce inference cost safely with explainable recommendations." Locking scope Friday EOD unless blockers.
Tom (Eng): will surface infra blockers by Thu EOD.
Kai (ML): adding a small harness tomorrow.
Riley (Solutions): collecting usage samples for ROI inputs.
Elena (PM): thanks all, closing loop.
